_README: Hand-curated water access points. No government agency maintains this list, which is why this file exists. Every entry carries its own provenance: `sourced` is where the detail came from and when; `needs_call` means a human has not yet phoned to confirm it is current. Never flip needs_call to false without actually calling. Prices and service areas change.

communities.name: Rio Verde Foothills
communities.note: Unincorporated area with no municipal water provider. Homes rely on hauled water or exempt wells. Scottsdale cut off hauled-water access on January 1, 2023; EPCOR opened a permanent standpipe on January 1, 2026.

entries.name: EPCOR Rio Verde Foothills Water Facility
entries.what: Permanent water filling station. This is the standpipe that replaced the Scottsdale supply cut off in 2023.
entries.address: 176th Street, south of Rio Verde Drive, Scottsdale, AZ
entries.access: Requires an EPCOR customer account and an access PIN. You cannot just drive up and fill without signing up first.
entries.sourced: EPCOR media release and AZFamily coverage, checked 2026-08-12

entries.name: Rio Verde Foothills Potable Water Hauling, LLC
entries.what: Delivers bulk potable water to residential holding tanks. Family owned, has served the area for 18+ years.
entries.address: 28150 N Alma School Pkwy, Scottsdale, AZ 85262
entries.access: Call to arrange delivery to your tank.
entries.sourced: Business listings and company site, checked 2026-08-12

entries.name: Dynamite Water
entries.what: Delivers bulk potable water to residential holding tanks. Says water is sanitized by the supplier and trucks are maintained to State of Arizona standards.
entries.access: Call for a service quote. Has served Rio Verde Foothills for 16+ years.

also_see.name: rvfhaswater.com
also_see.what: A resource built by Rio Verde Foothills residents themselves during the 2023 cutoff. Worth checking for community updates this directory may not have.
